description: This script is a test harness for verifying directory and file changes in git. It sets up directories and files, performs commits, then uses git diff to verify the changes are correctly identified.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up directories and files, commits initial state, performs further modifications, and commits again.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Runs git diff-tree to compare specific commits and verifies the output matches expectations.
